name: dosprout
description: Todo app: Next.js + Tailwind CSS frontend, Fastify + SQLite backend

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
